title.purpose: Page identity and primary workflow context.

label.purpose: Controls, metadata, table headings, and compact status.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, and surfaces that must visibly escape the workspace.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, selection, expansion, and compact state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact high-priority action using the current surface accent.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(48 87% 69%); color: hsl(222 47% 11%); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms, box-shadow 180ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: hsl(48 73% 56%); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(48 87% 69%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action on a slate surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(217 33% 25%); border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(217 33% 17%); color: hsl(210 40% 98%); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 180ms, border-color 180ms; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: hsl(217 33% 22%); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(48 87% 69%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark operational field with a high-visibility module-aware focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: hsl(215 20% 65%); font: 500 13px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(217 33% 25%); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(217 33% 17%); color: hsl(210 40% 98%); font: 400 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: hsl(48 87% 69%); outline: 2px solid hsl(48 87% 69% / 0.28); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state label with tint, text, and border carrying the same meaning.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 1px solid hsl(142 71% 45% / 0.35); border-radius: 999px; background: hsl(142 71% 45% / 0.12); color: hsl(142 65% 75%); font: 600 12px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Flat, bordered record group on the dark canvas.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(217 33% 24%); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(222 47% 11%); color: hsl(210 40% 98%); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 16px; } .ds-card span { color: hsl(215 20% 65%); font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: A dark, role-aware workspace where AVS yellow identifies the product and module colours provide functional wayfinding. Familiar controls, compact density, and high-contrast slate surfaces keep the interface focused on work.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: A screen has one dominant accent: AVS yellow for brand surfaces or the active module colour for module surfaces.

rules.name: The Readable Baseline Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts restructure before typography shrinks.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows are reserved for overlays, menus, and active elevation.

dos: Do reserve AVS yellow for brand identity, focus, and high-priority action.
Do use the active module colour consistently across navigation and workflow state.
Do expose clear loading, empty, error, and disabled states.
donts: Don't nest decorative cards merely to create spacing.
Don't use several saturated module colours at equal strength on one screen.
Don't globally shrink mobile typography to make a desktop layout fit.
